[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · **English** # agy-dart **Google Antigravity plugin — Save tokens · Improve cache hits · Keep cache warm on demand · Catch silent background quota burn · Rescue stalled chats** Zero extra dependencies · Works automatically in the background · Built-in right-sidebar dashboard [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-10b981.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node.js 22.16+ (22.x) or 24+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-22.16%2B_(22.x)_or_24%2B-38bdf8.svg)](package.json) [![Security Policy](https://img.shields.io/badge/Security-Policy-818cf8.svg)](SECURITY.md) [![Glama MCP](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart) [![Clones](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/repo-traffic-archive/main/badges/Antigravity-agy-dart.json)](https://github.com/zou172866/repo-traffic-archive) [How to Install](#how-to-install) · [Changelog](#changelog) · [Security](SECURITY.md) · [Third-Party Notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

--- ## What does this plugin do? `agy-dart` is a token-saving, cache-watching, and session-rescue plugin built for **Google Antigravity** (also supports DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, and Codex via `--target`). Once installed, it runs quietly in the background — **no new commands to memorize, just chat and code as usual**: ### 1. Combine small steps into fewer turns When the AI needs to search several terms, it runs them in one batch; when it edits multiple files, it edits them together and runs checks in the same step instead of resending your entire chat history turn after turn. ### 2. Block noisy output & read large files smartly If a test run dumps 3,000 lines of logs, the plugin passes only the key failure lines to the AI (e.g., line 42 failed, the other 199 passed) and keeps the full log locally for lookup. On huge code files, it hands over a line-numbered outline first so the AI reads only the lines it needs. ### 3. Monitor cache & keep it warm on demand The plugin keeps the controllable start of each request steady and cuts down repeated reads of unchanged files; actual cache hit rates still depend on how Antigravity builds requests and how the backend caches them (if you use a dynamic rotating proxy, pinning a single exit node is a useful controlled check). Automatic warming and expiry desktop alerts start off; once enabled, the default limit is 1 warm-up per chat until your next message, and both the count and interval can be changed in the panel. ### 4. Right-sidebar dashboard & crash/hang rescue See at a glance how much context space is left, how many minutes until cache expiry, and how much noise has been blocked. With multiple project windows open, if a background chat runs low on context or gets stuck spinning with zero output, a desktop alert names that project and chat — click it to jump right there. If a chat stalls or hits the limit, copy a progress summary in one click and continue in a fresh chat. ### 5. Catch silent background quota burn (Safety Monitor) Antigravity can occasionally re-review long chats in the background and quietly burn through your 5-hour quota or trigger 429 errors. The plugin watches local logs automatically (and keeps history even if a restart wipes the log): when everything is calm it stays collapsed to one quiet line; if a burn burst or quota cliff hits, the panel expands in plain language and gives you a one-click **Pack Progress & New Chat** button to stop the bleed. ### Other built-in features 1. **Keep your place after `/compact`**: Tracks modified files, latest test/build status, and saved reference IDs in the background so the AI picks right back up after compacting. 2. **Local search for long docs & web pages**: Saves multi-thousand-word docs or web pages locally by section and pulls only matching snippets by keyword. 3. **Filter huge logs & tables locally first**: On multi-MB logs, CSVs, or huge JSON dumps, the AI runs a quick local script to summarize (e.g., top 5 failing endpoints) and brings only the answer into chat; big JSON blobs automatically surface error rows. 4. **Workspace map on new chats**: Gives the AI a compact folder layout, script list, and core-file overview as soon as a new chat starts. 5. **Loop warnings**: Shows a UI-only note (never injected into model context) when the AI gets stuck in `edit → fail → revert → fail` cycles. 6. **Secret masking & sensitive-file protection**: Masks API keys and tokens in logs or web pages, blocks accidental reads of `.env` files when configured, and stops untrusted Git configs from running external commands. 7. **Keep tool replies under 8.8 KB**: Antigravity spills tool replies above ~10 KB into a temp file that costs an extra read turn; the plugin stays inside 8.8 KB and shifts leftover space from short passing checks to real error stack traces. 8. **Usage breakdown, inline diagnostic cards & one-click updates**: Inspect how much context goes to file reads, terminal output, or subagents, view 15-turn cache trends, see interactive inline cards when running `ctx_stats` / `ctx_doctor` (with one-click jump pills to open the side panel on Antigravity `v2.35.1+`), update right from the panel top bar, or replay past chats via CLI to estimate cache hits and warming cost. 9. **Plays nicely with your Skills + Skills bloat check**: Your Skills handle workflows while `agy-dart` quietly guards file reads, trims logs, and watches cache underneath; run `node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills` to see how much startup context each installed Skill uses. > Antigravity updates frequently — click **Star** at the top right to follow compatibility updates. --- ## How to Install Requires **Node.js 22.16+ (22.x) or Node.js 24+**. Zero third-party packages — the installer checks that Node's built-in SQLite search engine (FTS5 with trigram) is ready. ### Option 1: One-line terminal install (no clone needed) **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.9.3/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.9.3/install.sh | sh ``` ### Option 2: Let Antigravity install it Send this to Antigravity: ```text Clone tag v1.9.3 of https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git to a temp folder, run `node scripts/install.mjs install` (add `--install-rg` on Windows if `rg` is missing), and confirm `doctor` passes. ``` ### Option 3: Clone & install with custom flags ```powershell git clone --branch v1.9.3 --depth 1 https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git cd Antigravity-agy-dart # Windows PowerShell (optional -InstallRg auto-installs ripgrep) .\install.ps1 -InstallRg # macOS / Linux ./install.sh ``` **Other commands:** ```bash node scripts/install.mjs install # Global install (auto-syncs GEMINI_HOME & T3 ACP if present) node scripts/install.mjs install --project /repo/path # Single-project install node scripts/install.mjs doctor # Check install health node scripts/install.mjs uninstall # Uninstall ``` Restart or reload Antigravity after installing and open a new chat. Your own `rules/*.local.md` files are preserved across upgrades. If you previously installed standalone `agy-fast` or `antigravity-plugin-context-mode`, disable the old ones in your plugin list. Saved document indexes and usage history live locally in `~/.agy-dart/context.db` and stay intact on uninstall. To clear the current chat's index before uninstalling, call `ctx_purge` (when the host omits a session ID, this clears unattributed data for the current workspace); pass `scope: "all"` to wipe all projects. Global uninstall also removes installer-tracked Gemini/T3 copies and lists any older untracked copies with a dedicated removal command instead of deleting blindly. --- ## Settings Everyday switches live right in the **agy-dart Context** side panel: - **Auto-Keepalive (off by default)**: Turn it on for the current chat in the panel, or click **Warm 1×** next to the countdown anytime for a single manual ping. Use **Global Warm** to set the default count and schedule (**Auto**, **Fixed 4 / 9 / 15 min**, or **Custom 1–60 min**). Turning warming off for a chat also silences its expiry and limit alerts. > Note: Each warm-up asks the model for a short `OK` reply and uses input tokens (or the full conversation if the cache already expired). - **Desktop alerts (off by default)**: Cache expiry, stalled-chat alerts, and background quota burn alerts (**Burn Alert: OFF/ON**) all start off and can be toggled individually. - **One-click & automatic updates**: Click **Check Update** / **Update Now** in the top bar anytime, or toggle **Auto-Update: OFF/ON** (off by default) for silent same-major upgrades. - **Other panel controls**: Pause protection, clear old local data, and adjust file-size limits directly in the panel. Preset read limits & tool-loading modes via CLI: ```bash node scripts/install.mjs mode host-45k # Default: direct read up to 45 KB code / 128 KB patches, block >16 KB noisy logs node scripts/install.mjs mode balanced-16k # Outline first above 16 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode fast-32k # Raise normal file limit to 32 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode strict-8k # Block above 8 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode no-read-hook # Never block file reads, only trim noisy terminal output node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading fast-eager # Default: 4 fast tools eager, 8 context tools lazy node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading lazy # All 12 tools lazy-loaded node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading eager # All 12 tools eager-loaded ```
Troubleshooting: ide-tools duplicate /required schema error If Antigravity fails during toolbox initialization with `building toolbox: tool "mcp_ide-tools_mcp_agy-dart_fast_apply_edits" advertises an invalid parameter schema ... at '/required': items at 1 and 2 are equal`, the host's `ide-tools` bridge is duplicating `toolSummary` in `/required`. Switch to lazy loading and restart Antigravity: ```bash node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-dart/scripts/install.mjs tool-loading lazy ``` (Or remove `"tools"` / `"eager": true` under `mcpServers.fast` in `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-dart/mcp_config.json` and restart. See [skills/agy-dart/references/error-playbook.md](skills/agy-dart/references/error-playbook.md) for diagnostics.)

## What's New in v1.9.3 (includes v1.9.0, v1.9.1 & v1.9.2)

> Since `v1.8.2` was the previous GitHub Release, this release rolls up the full **v1.9.0** official Antigravity alignment, **v1.9.1** zero-regression slimming, **v1.9.2** red-team security & reliability hardening, and **v1.9.3** Catppuccin Mocha dark theme & section quick-jump ([PR #8](https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/pull/8), thanks `@Ansg2022`!) into one clean upgrade.

### 简体中文

#### v1.9.3 — Catppuccin Mocha 暗黑主题、卡片分层与顶栏锚点快跳
- **Catppuccin Mocha 暗黑主题与首屏防白闪（感谢 `@Ansg2022` 贡献 [#8](https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/pull/8)）**：
  - 右侧 Sidecar 面板新增完整的 Catppuccin Mocha 深色主题，默认自动跟随系统深浅色。
  - 左键点击主题按钮即可在 Light 与 Mocha 深色间瞬时切换；右键点击或键盘 `Shift+Click` / `Shift+Enter` 恢复跟随系统。
  - `<head>` 内嵌 `<script data-theme-init>` 防白闪（FOUC）脚本，暗黑模式下首次打开无刺眼白屏闪烁。
- **卡片视觉分层与顶栏分节锚点快跳**：
  - 统一优化卡片层次、边框与次级指示点对比度（非文本对比度 ≥3:1），观感更清晰。
  - 顶栏新增吸顶分节快跳胶囊条与滚动高亮追踪（scroll-spy），补齐 `nearBottom` 与点击锁定的防抢跳保护、全宽度窄侧边栏零裁切折行（无头 Edge CDP 实测 `300px–820px` 全状态 0 溢出/0 重叠）及 `beforeunload` 资源清理。

#### v1.9.2 — 红队复核安全与稳定性加固
- **内联诊断卡片安全与体验加固**：
  - 修复 `ctx_stats` 卡片点击「刷新」时重放初始 `reset: true` 的问题，强制只读刷新（`reset: false`），不再误清空当前会话数据。
  - 修复 `ctx_doctor` 卡片 Safety Monitor 告警内容，正确展示真实 `diagnosis` 与处置建议（`recommendedAction`）。
  - 加固 SEP-1865 协议与前端边界：校验 `event.source === window.parent`、宿主 CSS 变量白名单与 `background-color`（阻断 `url(...)` 与内部变量覆盖）、补齐 `ui/resource-teardown` 清理响应，并收严 `context/server.js` 的 `mimeTypes` 协商。
- **`ConversationService` 回环边界与无上限历史 SQLite 加固**：
  - 为 `localhost` 补齐 DNS 解析后回环 IP 校验（严格限定 `127.0.0.0/8` / `::1`）、独立墙钟总超时（防慢速滴水绕过）、HTTP 200 响应契约/ID 一致性校验，以及 Sidecar 发送路径共享 60 秒不支持接口退避。
  - 修复 `conversations_fts` 超过 32 行时的归档漏判、独占锁下的共享截止时间与不污染负缓存、原子 CAS 清理过期租约（`deleteWatchdogLeaseIfUnchanged`）、扫描缓存 WAL 失效、索引感知最近会话查询及 `opendirSync` 流式目录遍历。
- **读守卫、批量编辑恢复点、模拟器与跨宿主升级修复**：
  - 大文件跨 2 MiB 探测边界不再误放行宽行读取；`apply_edits(verify)` 改传结构化验证结果，50 文件长路径触发 8.8 KB 截断时仍准确写入失败恢复点。
  - `cache-simulator.js` 对齐 Gemini 4 的 2,050 token 尾部重算规则；DSH/Claude/Codex 升级同步清理 8 个退役文档/SVG；自更新备用清单补齐 `dsh/` 并排除退役 SVG；恢复 `fast/session-start.mjs` 单文件独立运行、统一 `truncateUtf8Safe` 孤立代理项处理并修正 `cache-audit` Markdown 总数明细。
  - _看门狗策略说明：无档位后缀的 `gemini-4-carbon`/`neon` 刻意保留 600s 保护性高推理阈值以防长思考误报卡死，显式 `-low`/`-medium` 走常规阈值。_

#### v1.9.1 — 零回退瘦身（Token / 安装体积 / 重复代码）
- **开场规则与排错文档进一步瘦身（零减功能）**：默认首轮开场占用降至 **`~1,289` token**（全量目录 `1,885` token）；精简 `SKILL.md` 与 `error-playbook.md`，按需读取排错文档一次直省约 **3,278 token（-36%）**。
- **安装目录更轻**：不再把 GitHub 展示用双语 README 与 6 张宣传图 SVG 复制到本机插件目录（`RUNTIME_FILES` 从 `72 → 64` 文件 / `-112 KB`，保留合规文件与 `assets/logo.svg`）。
- **死代码清理与共享逻辑收口**：零新增文件合并 6 处钩子公共逻辑至 `hooks/compile-cache.mjs`，统一 5 处 `truncateUtf8Safe` 至 `context/lib/stable-json.js`（核心代码净减 `429` 行）。

#### v1.9.0 — 官方规范深度对齐
- **Gemini 4 95% 缓存折扣与分档计价**：更新 Carbon/Argon、Neon、Hydrogen 变体的 95% 缓存折扣、4,096 token 起步门槛与 2,050 token 增量规则，账本和成本估算更准、提高自动续温 ROI 门槛。
- **交互式内联诊断卡片与轻量返回**：在 Antigravity `v2.34.0+` 桌面端运行 `ctx_stats` / `ctx_doctor` 时渲染自动跟随深浅色的内联诊断卡片，同时只给模型传极简摘要；`v2.35.1+` 支持 `sidecar://agy-dart/dashboard/` 一键直达右侧面板；CLI/IDE 端保持单行紧凑 JSON。
- **无限历史对话不卡顿**：Watchdog 与 Sidecar 优先走本机回环 `ConversationService` API，老版本平滑退回带缓存和预算封顶的本地扫描。
- **分段读更准、`/swarm` 协作隔离与低开销钩子**：支持 `.heic`/`.avif`/`.amr` 与 PDF 按页直放、精准隔离 `/swarm` 子工位、精简 `PostToolUse`、对齐 `310s` MCP 超时与 `cache-audit` v2。

---

### English

#### v1.9.3 — Catppuccin Mocha Dark Theme, Card Hierarchy Polish & Section Quick-Jump
- **Catppuccin Mocha dark theme & zero-flash startup (thanks `@Ansg2022` in [#8](https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/pull/8))**:
  - Added a complete Catppuccin Mocha dark theme to the Sidecar dashboard with automatic OS theme detection.
  - Left-click toggles smoothly between Light and Mocha dark; right-click or keyboard `Shift+Click` / `Shift+Enter` resets back to system auto mode.
  - Added an inline `<script data-theme-init>` FOUC guard in `<head>` so dark mode renders immediately with zero white flash.
- **Card hierarchy polish & sticky topbar section quick-jump**:
  - Refined Sidecar card layering, borders, and muted indicator contrast (≥3:1 non-text contrast).
  - Added a sticky topbar section quick-jump pill bar with active scroll-spy tracking, `nearBottom` & click-pinning jump protection, full narrow-sidebar wrapping (`300px–820px` verified across 40 states in headless Edge CDP with zero overflow/overlap), and `beforeunload` resource cleanup.

#### v1.9.2 — Red-Team Security & Reliability Hardening
- **MCP Apps diagnostics card safety & UX hardening**:
  - Fixed `ctx_stats` Refresh button to remain strictly read-only (`reset: false`, never replaying an initial `reset: true`).
  - Wired `ctx_doctor` Safety Monitor alerts to display actual `diagnosis` and `recommendedAction` text.
  - Hardened SEP-1865 boundaries: enforced `event.source === window.parent`, strict host CSS variable allowlists + `background-color` (blocking `url(...)` / internal overrides), `ui/resource-teardown` timer/observer cleanup, and strict `mimeTypes` negotiation in `context/server.js`.
- **Loopback `ConversationService` & unlimited-history SQLite hardening**:
  - Added post-DNS loopback IP verification for `localhost` (`127.0.0.0/8` / `::1` only), hard wall-clock total request deadlines (preventing slow-drip hangs), strict HTTP 200 contract/ID validation, and shared 60s unsupported-endpoint backoff on Sidecar keepalive sends.
  - Fixed `conversations_fts` archive detection past row 32, shared lock deadlines without negative-cache poisoning on transient `SQLITE_BUSY`, atomic CAS lease deletion (`deleteWatchdogLeaseIfUnchanged`), WAL-aware transcript scan invalidation, index-aware recent-ID SQL, and streaming `opendirSync` directory scans.
- **Read-guard, batch-edit checkpoints, simulator & multi-host upgrade fixes**:
  - Required exact full measurements before unlocking wide line ranges on >2 MiB files; passed structured `apply_edits(verify)` results directly so failure checkpoints persist even when 50-file outputs truncate at 8.8 KB.
  - Aligned `cache-simulator.js` with Gemini 4's 2,050-token tail-reprocess rule, pruned retired README/SVG files on shared DSH/Claude/Codex upgrades, updated self-update fallback manifests (`dsh/` + `assets/logo.svg` only), restored standalone single-file `fast/session-start.mjs`, normalized lone UTF-16 surrogates consistently in `truncateUtf8Safe`, and aligned `cache-audit` Markdown totals.
  - _Watchdog policy note: un-suffixed `gemini-4-carbon`/`neon` intentionally stay in the protective 600s high-reasoning tier to prevent false stall alerts during extended thinking; explicit `-low`/`-medium` suffixes remain on the standard tier._

#### v1.9.1 — Zero-Regression Slimming
- **Leaner Turn-0 & on-demand skill docs**: Default startup footprint trimmed to **`~1,289` tokens** (full catalog `1,885` tokens); `SKILL.md` + `error-playbook.md` tightened to save **~3,278 tokens (-36%)** on demand.
- **Smaller local install footprint**: Pruned 8 GitHub-only README/SVG assets from local installs (`RUNTIME_FILES` `72 → 64` files / `-112 KB`, preserving compliance docs and `assets/logo.svg`).
- **Dead-code & helper consolidation**: Deduplicated 6 hook boilerplate copies into `hooks/compile-cache.mjs` (zero new files) and unified 5 `truncateUtf8Safe` copies into `context/lib/stable-json.js` (`-429` core lines).

#### v1.9.0 — Official Antigravity Alignment
- **Gemini 4 95% cache & pricing model**: Updated savings math, per-variant pricing (Carbon/Argon, Neon, Hydrogen), 4,096-token minimum cacheable threshold, 2,050-token multi-turn delta rule, and higher keepalive ROI floor.
- **Interactive MCP Apps inline cards**: `ctx_stats` and `ctx_doctor` render theme-aware inline cards with built-in Refresh on Antigravity `v2.34.0+` while returning compact text to the model; `sidecar://agy-dart/dashboard/` link on `v2.35.1+`; compact JSON on CLI/IDE hosts.
- **Unlimited-history performance (`ConversationService` API)**: Watchdog and Sidecar query the local loopback `ConversationService` API first, falling back cleanly to bounded, cached SQLite/directory scans.
- **Smarter read slicing, `/swarm` isolation & leaner hooks**: Accurate slice-byte measurement, `.heic`/`.avif`/`.amr` & PDF page-slice passthrough, `/
